name: sface
role: 128-d face embedding for identity matching (Expansion Plan Phase F; PLAN.md section 7)
licence_verified: 2026-09-15. Read models/face_recognition_sface/LICENSE in opencv_zoo, confirmed Apache-2.0.
runtime: cv2.FaceRecognizerSF (OpenCV's own wrapper). alignCrop() must run on every embed call using YuNet's 5-point landmarks - the model was trained against aligned faces, and skipping alignment measurably degrades match quality.

files.output: fc1: [1, 128] - the embedding, already decoded, no post-processing needed
files.match_threshold: 0.363 cosine similarity - OpenCV's own documented default for this model
